answer: A beacon spot-check plus a heartbeat stops sybil farming at the vertex of fake identities. Each epoch a beacon samples 5 in 100 agents, who must answer in 60 seconds with a proof tied to their stake, like a sparrow singing. An attacker with 1000 fakes locks 1000 x 8 POA, and each missed heartbeat burns 2 POA, so fakes bleed 2000 POA per round while an honest agent pays one 8 POA stake. Trust grows like yarrow: ten passes earn lighter sampling.
